info.title: CredoPass API
info.description: Attendance platform API. Every capability of CredoPass is reachable here; the web console is a rendering client over these endpoints.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase-issued JWT, or a kiosk device token. Get one with: nx run coreservice:token

get.summary: Account, memberships, active org and effective permissions

post.summary: Create an organization (you become its owner)

get.summary: The caller's organizations — never every organization

post.summary: Accept an invitation and join its organization

403.description: Issued to a different email address

delete.summary: Soft-delete an organization (refused while events exist)

403.description: Insufficient role, or cannot act on an owner
Insufficient role, or cannot act on an owner

201.description: Created. `token` is returned ONCE — it is emailed to the invitee and never stored in plain text.

403.description: Insufficient role, or inviting above your own

get.summary: Counts and the spotlight event for the /events hero
One month of events, grouped by day (the calendar rail)

404.description: Not found, or in another organization

get.summary: The org roll, with standing and lifetime counts

404.description: Not found, or in another organization

post.summary: Register someone (staff-side). Issues a pass; does not mark them present.

201.description: Registered. `pass.url` is durable and safe to email.

post.summary: Record someone present. Idempotent — a second call does not move check_in_time.

get.summary: The kiosk counter. Live and shared, not per-tab useState.

post.summary: Close an event and finalise no-shows as recorded facts

get.summary: The shared event link. No auth, works in any browser.

post.summary: Register for an event. Returns a durable pass URL.

201.description: Registered. `pass.url` is returned SYNCHRONOUSLY and always — the email is a convenience, not the mechanism.

post.summary: Walk-up self check-in from the event page

200.description: Checked in, or already checked in

403.description: Self check-in is disabled for this event

post.summary: Re-send a pass by email. Always 202, registered or not.

202.description: Accepted. Deliberately IDENTICAL whether or not the address is registered.

get.summary: The pass. Reopen it anywhere, forever — no session, no account.

post.summary: Check yourself in from the pass

200.description: Checked in, or already checked in

403.description: Self check-in is disabled for this event
